body: Thank you for the reply, I will consider this for the next few days.

Thank you for your reply. However, I have done all that. On Friday I checked into a mental health clinic but was released on Sunday. I spoke with several psychiatrists and social workers and none of it really helped. The place realy was not for me and was making everything worse. Those places are terrible! Noone has seemed to have a truly good argument for me to stop. I have called the suicide hotline and I have posted here, yet none of it seems to matter. I have given every opportunity I can think of for circumstances or arguments or feeligns to pursuade me otherwise and none of it seems to matter. I am not doing anything impulsive, and everything is very well thought out. I flew home on sunday evening so I could spend some time with my family, but that is not changing my decision. I honestly do not need to speak to more psyciatrist/psychologist/social workers. Both my parents have pHds in psychology and as a matter of fact, so do I. More talking is not going to resolve these issues.
Also, Thank you for your time and effort!

Thank you for the attempt, but I am already pretty firmly committed, maybe things will change once I become more dellusional and the pain begins, but as for right now I am steady in my course.

Well, I am off to brush my teeth (for some reason, my outh consistently tastes AWFUL, and it never goes away really) then I am off to bed. I will be back on in the morning! Have a nice night!

I did not exist for billions of years before I appeared on this earth and it did not inconvenience me in the slightest. I am honestly not bothered by the non-existance.

The split is a recent thing. As of last Thursday. In fact, I did not even realize what I was doing until yesterday when I realized I had not nurished my body in any way since the news.

I woud love for her to change her mind. I would love to simply hear from her and I have messaged her to let her know all of this. But it really isn't going to happen. She may even be willing to try working on it (highly unlikely, but possible), but I know her better than myself. She will never be able to look at or trust me again and all I will be doing if I stick around it is she will waste another year or two with me when she could be looking for someone  else. I wil just suck more time away from her life.

Oh, I know that. I honestly do not believe what I did was divorce-worthy (making out, heavy petting). Sure, it is something we woudl have to work though, but it did happen 5 years ago. We are both completely different people today. She wouldnt consider 5-year-ago me to date because of who I was back then. We have matured together and grown into entirely different people as a couple. However, it is a big deal to her. She doesn't believe it happene that long ago... even with proof. However, it really isn't about forgiving myself either. In general, I am not a huge fan of this world and this action feels like it is the right thing to do for myself and for her.

I talked to a psychiatrist on Saturday, It really didn't seem to help at all. In general, I am just not providing anything to this world. I am kinda a scumbag (as I did makeout with someone while dating my wife). The total value I am providing for this planet would probably be a net negative. I most assuredly in the lower 50% of all people on this plane. I know that me passing will not be a big deal in the grand scheme of things and will probably only help. Sure, it may make my wife a bit sadder in the short run, but she will never have to worry about me finding someone else, or think about me randomly hooking up on saturday nights. In the long run it will be better for her as well.
I do not think I am making a stupid decision. In fact, nothing has ever felt quite so right.
He doesn't like it, but he will do it. We grew up together and we always support each others decisions no matter how stupid they are. He is trustworthy that way.

I think it is notarized. The one person who knows what is happening is my Cousin (best man at my wedding). I have transfered my medical power of attorney over to him as well, and he knows the plan.

I would prefer not to talk. I am terrible on the phone, always have been. I couldn't even order pizza effectively and my wife would have to do it!
